correctness.rationale: The RKHS feature map Φ=(1,√b cosθ,√b sinθ) makes optimal unrestricted-weight error the squared orthogonal distance from mean feature to the span of two sampled features. A normal vector (−√b cos(Δ/2),cosψ,sinψ) yields the exact conditional orientation-averaged error b[a² cos²(Δ/2)+(u²+v²)/8]/[1+b cos²(Δ/2)]. Under constant diagonal, RP residual gives difference density q_b=4(1−cosΔ)(1+b cos²(Δ/2))/(b+4); iid difference is uniform. Integrating yields RP b/(b+4)(a²+(u²+v²)/2), iid (1−1/√(1+b))a²+b(u²+v²)/(8√(1+b)). Algebraic subtraction factors into ((√(1+b)−1)(√(1+b)−3)/(√(1+b)(b+4)))(a²−b(u²+v²)/8), establishing b=8 and t=√(8/b) exact sign classifications for nonnegative g=1+t cos. An independent numerical integration check covered 28 parameter-target combinations, not an infinite proof.
